name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Analysis in Freesurfer Space (Benson pRF)
summary: Generates ROIs for visual white matter analysis in FreeSurfer (T1) space: V1 from a pRF visual-area segmentation, left and right LGN from FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei, the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.
description: Same ROI set as the DWI-space visual white matter ROI App, but kept in FreeSurfer anatomical space: LGN from the thalamic nuclei segmentation, the optic chiasm, FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs merged into one 'exclusion' ROI, and visual areas from the pRF varea segmentation, with optional inflation into white matter. Use it when tracking or analysis is done in T1/FreeSurfer space. The FreeSurfer input must include the thalamic nuclei segmentation.

inputs.description: Path to the freesurfer datatype. This NEEDS to have been run through segment thalamic nuclei app, or have the thalamic nuclei generated in the original freesurfer generation, for this to work. This is used to generate the LGN ROIs.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the thalamic nuclei segmentation (mri/ThalamicNuclei.*.mgz), e.g. from the Segment thalamic nuclei App.

inputs.description: This is the path to the prf datatype. This NEEDS to have a visual area segmentation (varea.nii.gz) for this to work. This is used to generate V1. The Benson anatomical atlas can be used to generate this segmentation.

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation of the visual-area ROIs in FreeSurfer space, with key.txt and label.json.
Directory of individual binary NIfTI ROIs in FreeSurfer space: left and right LGN, optic chiasm, a merged FreeSurfer exclusion ROI and the pRF visual-area ROIs.
